# Producer Toy

> Producer Toy is the premier marketplace for modern music creators, producers, and audio engineers. It offers a curated collection of world-class VST plugins, synthesizer presets (Serum, Vital, Sylenth1), royalty-free sample packs, drum kits, and DAW project templates.

## Key Features
- **100% Royalty-Free:** All sample packs, sound banks, loops, and presets include a perpetual commercial license for music streaming (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube), sync licensing, and commercial releases with zero royalty splits.
- **Studio-Standard Audio & Code:** Audio samples are delivered in pristine 24-bit WAV format (44.1kHz / 48kHz). Plugins are delivered in 64-bit VST3, AU, and AAX formats compatible with Windows 10/11 and macOS (including native Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4 & Intel).
- **Curated Free Producer Toys:** Over 100+ verified, top-tier free VST plugins and sound packs tested by professional audio engineers.
- **Instant High-Speed Delivery:** Secure cloud downloads with lifetime library access and instant license key delivery.

## Categories & Software Types
- **Audio Effect Plugins:** Saturation, Tape Warmth, Dynamic Equalizers, Algorithmic Reverbs, Delays, Bus Compressors, Analog Limiters, Pitch Correction, and Vocal Processors.
- **Virtual Instruments & Synths:** Synthesizers, Acoustic & Electric Guitars, Bass VSTs, Orchestral Strings, and Samplers.
- **Sample Packs & Sound Libraries:** Hip-Hop & Trap Drum Kits, 808 Bass Loops, Drill Rhythms, Melody Stems, Vocal Chops, and Lofi Textures.
- **Synth Presets:** Professional banks for Xfer Serum, Vital Synth, Native Instruments Massive, and Arturia plugins.
- **DAW Project Templates:** Fully mixed and mastered workflow templates for FL Studio, Ableton Live, Logic Pro, and Cubase.
